description: Epoch AI 'AI Models' dataset — notable/frontier/large-scale ML models with training compute, parameters, dataset size, organizations, release dates.

body.how_to_read: Four filtered views of the same registry; all_ai_models is the superset. Key columns include model name, organization, domain, training-compute (FLOP), parameters, training-dataset size, and publication/release date. Columns vary per view — read the CSV header. Use for compute-trend / model-scaling context, not chip-component spend.

methodology.summary: As-downloaded Epoch AI 'AI Models' export, cleaned by the epoch_ai ingest, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12. Confidence 0.8 (curated CC BY 4.0 dataset).
